summary: Backend smoke + integration testing for NIVARA. All 21 request items covered. Every core endpoint returns expected status codes and payloads. AI (Claude) is live: SVI scoring, risk levels, indicators, and case summary all working. Role-based access control and JWT auth enforced correctly. Only minor observation: /api/sos requires 'latitude'/'longitude' (not 'lat'/'lng' as mentioned in the request); frontend should use the full field names.
passed: GET /api/health -> 200 {status: ok}
POST /api/auth/register (victim role) -> 200 with JWT + user
POST /api/auth/login for victim/officer/counsellor demo users -> 200 with JWT
GET /api/auth/me with valid JWT -> 200 returns profile
GET /api/auth/me with invalid JWT -> 401 Invalid token
GET /api/users/counsellors (officer) -> 200 returns [Dr. Priya]
POST /api/chat (victim) msg1 -> SVI=62 (High), indicators include threat/fear/safety_concern, case created
POST /api/chat (victim) msg2 with same case_id -> case reused, SVI escalated to 82 (Critical), history preserved
POST /api/sos with latitude/longitude -> ok, case upgraded to emergency priority and SVI=85 Critical
GET /api/cases/mine victim -> only their own case
GET /api/cases/mine officer -> all cases sorted (emergency first)
GET /api/cases/mine counsellor -> empty before assign, populated after assign
GET /api/cases/{id} -> full detail with case, interactions[], actions/notes/followups
POST /api/officer/assign -> ok, case status becomes 'assigned', counsellor linked
POST /api/officer/action -> ok
POST /api/counsellor/note (assigned counsellor) -> ok
POST /api/counsellor/followup -> ok
POST /api/case/status -> ok, status updates to in_progress
POST /api/cases/summary/{case_id} (officer) -> AI-generated case summary returned and stored
GET /api/notifications -> 200 (returns list)
RBAC: victim -> /api/officer/action returns 403 'Requires role: officer'
RBAC: victim -> /api/counsellor/note returns 403 'Requires role: counsellor'
RBAC: unrelated counsellor -> /api/cases/{id} returns 403 'Not your assigned case'

failed.issue: /api/sos body schema uses 'latitude'/'longitude'; test spec (and possibly frontend) mentioned lat/lng. Sending lat/lng returns 422.
failed.evidence: POST /api/sos {lat, lng} -> 422 Field required: body.latitude/body.longitude. Using {latitude, longitude} works (200 ok).

failed.issue: GET /api/notifications returned [] for both officer and victim after assign+SOS. Assign endpoint claims to create notification but none surfaced.
failed.evidence: curl /api/notifications with officer/victim JWT -> [] after successful /api/officer/assign and /api/sos calls.

action_items: Confirm frontend SOS payload uses 'latitude'/'longitude' (matching backend schema) or align backend to accept lat/lng aliases.
Investigate why /api/notifications returns empty despite assign/SOS creating notification rows (recipient filter or role mismatch in query).
